reason: PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_2^*(2460)- pi+ , D^*_2()- --> D0 pi-'. A D_2*(2460)- (anti-c d) decays strongly to Dbar0 pi-; D0 pi- would change charm by two units. The listing means Dbar0 pi-, as it writes for S042.320 and S042.419.
PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_0^*(2400)- pi+ , D^*_0()- --> D0 pi-'. Same misprint as S042.124: a D_0*- decays to Dbar0 pi-, as the listing writes for S042.554 and S042.418.
PDG text: 'B0 --> D_sJ(2457)+ D^*(2010) , D_sJ()+ --> D_s()+ gamma', without the charge of the D*. Charge conservation in a B0 decay with a D_sJ+ fixes it to D*(2010)-.

PDG text: 'B0 --> D+- D^*()-+ (CP-averaged)' (6.14e-4): the sum of the two charge states D*+ D- and D*- D+, which the decay file lists as two lines of 3.05e-4. Confirmed with the source, Belle arXiv:1203.6647: B(B0 -> D*+- D-+) = (6.14 +- 0.29 +- 0.50)e-4 from one yield of both charge states.

PDG text: 'B0 --> D^*(2010)+ D-' = 6.12e-4, equal to S042.511 'D+- D^*()-+ (CP-averaged)' = 6.14e-4; read as the same charge sum, it would give the D*+ D- line c = 2 and leave D*- D+ without a node. Its own sources were not checked; S042.511 (confirmed to be the sum, 2.6 times more precise) fixes both lines, so this entry is not needed.

PDG text: 'B+ --> psi(2S) K_1(1270)+ , K_1(1270)+ --> K+ pi+ pi-' (3.30e-5) is listed next to '[ same ](P-wave)' S041.859 (3.26e-5) and '[ same ](D-wave)' S041.860 (2.96e-5), whose sum exceeds it: one component of the psi(2S) K+ pi+ pi- amplitude fit, not the total rate.

M2 (2026-11-17). Decay-file line 'anti-D*0 pi- e+ nu_e' is the non-resonant (Goity-Roberts) part. PDG has no measurement of it: S042.312 'B0 --> Dbar^*()0 pi- lepton+ nu_lepton' is the total and includes the D** states. M2 (2026-11-17). B0 --> D_0*- e+ nu has only an upper limit in PDG (S042.418, product with D_0*- --> Dbar0 pi- < 4.4e-4). The isospin partner B+ --> Dbar_0*0 l+ nu is measured as a product (S041.503). Semileptonic b --> c decays conserve isospin, so the B0 line takes the c of the B+ line. Accepted: the corrected B0 product stays above the limit, within the B+ error.

D1 (2026-11-17). PDG text: 'B0 --> D- a_1(1260)+' = (0.60 +- 0.33) %, an old measurement with 54 % error. The decay-file line D- a_1+ (line 697, 1.071 %) carries the comment 'Interpreting D3pi BF as fully (D- a1(->3pi)) decay': its BF is the D- pi+ pi+ pi- total divided by B(a_1+ --> pi+ pi+ pi-). The total S042.88 (0.598 +- 0.061 %) is the measurement the line was built from and is five times more precise, so the line is compared with it (direct_line entry) and this entry is not used.

D1 (2026-11-17). PDG text: 'B0 --> D- pi+ pi+ pi-' = (0.598 +- 0.061) %. The decay file has no direct D- pi+ pi+ pi- line: it routes the whole final state through D- a_1+ (line 697, comment 'Interpreting D3pi BF as fully (D- a1(->3pi)) decay'). The line therefore stands for this inclusive final state and takes its c from the total, after the other lines that feed it.

D2 (2026-11-17). The c of 'D- D_s0*+' comes from PDG products with D_s0*(2317)+ --> D_s+ pi0. The decay file sends the D_s0* to D_s+ pi0 in 100 % of the cases; PDG gives B(D_s0* --> D_s pi0) = (100 +0 -20) %. If the sub-decay is below 100 %, the B rate and c are larger by up to 25 %; 20 % is added in quadrature to sigma_c.

2026-11-17. B0 --> psi(3770) K0 (lines 592-594: K0 with BF 0, K_S0, K_L0) has only product upper limits in PDG (S042.393, S042.394), and the decay file is above them. The isospin partner B+ --> psi(3770) K+ is measured (S041.360). b --> c cbar s decays conserve isospin, so the B0 lines take the B+ value divided by the lifetime ratio.

G3 (2026-11-17). PDG text: 'B+ --> Dbar_1^*(2420)0 rho+' < 1.4e-3 (S041.215, CLEO). The decay file (line 4319) has 3.72e-3, set as twice B+ --> anti-D_10 pi+ (the D**rho = 2 x D**pi assumption of BELLE2-NOTE-PH-2022-002), 2.7 times the limit. The line takes c = limit/2 +- limit/2, i.e. 0.19 +- 0.19.

P1 option P+, 2026-11-17. The weight comes from PDG's per-channel products S041.361 (x B(psi(3770) --> D0 Dbar0), 1.55e-4) and S041.362 (x B(psi --> D+ D-), 0.94e-4): c = 0.53 +- 0.13. The total S041.360 is excluded for this line (see that entry). The LHCb amplitude analysis (arXiv:2009.00026) gives a psi(3770) fit fraction of 14.5 +- 1.4 % of B+ --> D+ D- K+, i.e. c = 0.16 with the PDG D+D-K+ total; 65 % is added in quadrature to sigma_c (0.13 --> 0.37) so that it lies about 1 sigma away (1.0 sigma with the widened error).

P1 option P+, 2026-11-17. PDG text: 'B+ --> psi(3770) K+' = 4.34e-4, the average of Belle 2004 (Chistov, 4.8e-4) and BaBar 2020 (Lees, recoil method, 3.2 +- 2.1 e-4) (pdgapi listing). Belle 2004's value is not a measurement of its own: it is the sum of its D0Dbar0 and D+D- products, assuming they saturate psi(3770) decays, and its D0Dbar0 product (3.4e-4) is superseded in S041.361 by Belle 2008 (2.2e-4, 4.7 times the data). The products S041.361 and S041.362 are used instead (c = 0.53); divided by PDG's psi(3770) branching fractions they imply a total of 2.6 +- 0.6 e-4, consistent with BaBar 2020 and with Belle 2018 (< 2.3e-4).

PDG text: 'B0 --> D^*(2010)- K0 pi+' = 3.0e-4, from one measurement, BaBar 2005 (hep-ex/0412040): B(B0 --> D*-+ K0 pi+-) = (3.0 +- 0.7 +- 0.3)e-4, with K_S0, i.e. both charge combinations together (the paper writes -+/+- throughout). The decay file has D*- K0 pi+ (line 797) and D*+ K0 pi- (line 798) with 3.0e-4 each; read as the sum, as for S042.511 (D3).

G6 (2026-11-17). B+ --> anti-D*0 K+ K*0 (line 4349, 1.5e-3) needs two anti-strange quarks (Delta S = 2) and is not expected. Its BF is Belle 2002's measurement of B- --> D*0 K- K*0 (hep-ex/0207041, 15.3e-4; conjugate: B+ --> anti-D*0 K+ anti-K*0), conjugated without flipping the K*0. The allowed mode is line 4345 (2021 update, total minus the anti-D*0 a_1+ part); c = 0. The B- line 5888 (D*0 K- anti-K*0) is its conjugate and inherits c = 0; the allowed B- line 5892 (D*0 K- K*0, 1.5e-3) takes the corrected BF of line 4345 (cp_transfer).
